title: AFRC 75th Anniversary Series Episode 10- Flight Loads
description: NASA Armstrong’s Flight research center is honoring 75 years of advancing technology and science through flight.  For the next year there will be monthly reoccurring videos released to help tell the past 75 years of NASA Armstrong. This month’s theme is flight loads! Learn about the history of the X-planes; from the X-1 to the upcoming X-59 & more!  Stay updated with NASA Armstrong’s 75th anniversary celebrations: https://www.nasa.gov/centers/armstrong/about/75years/index.html  Follow us @NASAArmstrong on Twitter, Facebook & Instagram.  The majority of archival footage and sound used in this video are in the public domain and can be found in government records, the Internet Archive, or Wikimedia Commons.
keywords: Neil A. Armstrong Flight Research Center, X-Plane, Flight, Aircraft, Flight Loads, AFRC, AFRC 75th Anniversary
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
